summary.tldr: Amends the Indian Act to create new registration rights in the Indian Register and related Band List rights for some people.
what_it_does: Creates new entitlements to registration in the Indian Register under the Indian Act.
Gives people who become entitled the right to have their names entered in a Band List kept by the Department of Indigenous Services.
summary.background: The bill responds to a Charter challenge to certain provisions of the Indian Act in Nicholas v. Canada (Attorney General).
